page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system deployment and data persistence. It contains no GPU accelerators, relying entirely on the host CPU for all computational tasks. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance.

Due to the 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from hyperthreading. It is suitable for lightweight web servers, batch processing, and distributed compute nodes where memory requirements are minimal.
